mapper.select: SELECT wm.workspace_id, wm.user_id AS recipient_id, wm.status, wm.membership_id, w.org_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.lifecycle_state AS workspace_lifecycle_state, o.lifecycle_state AS organization_lifecycle_state FROM workspace_member wm JOIN workspace w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY wm.workspace_id
SELECT workspace_id, user_id AS recipient_id, status, membership_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{recipientId} FOR SHARE
SELECT workspace_id, user_id AS recipient_id, status, membership_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{recipientId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{actorId} FOR SHARE
